lead.t: The findings are characteristic for schwannoma, called an acoustic neuroma when the 8th cranial nerve is involved.

snip.t: The findings are characteristic for schwannoma, called an acoustic neuroma when the 8th cranial nerve is involved.

The most common schwannomas, termed vestibular schwannomas or acoustic neuromas, arise from the vestibular portion of the eighth cranial nerve and account for approximately 9% of primary brain tumors.
Presents with tinnitus + hearing loss ("acoustic neuroma" = misnomer — not acoustic nerve, not a neuroma)
